title: Fall 2026: Bedford wins Greater Boston
text:
The Fall 2026 regular season is complete in the Greater Boston division. Bedford won the division with 9 match wins (106 games won), ahead of Lexington (8) and Newton (7).

Bedford will start the playoffs as soon as next week against the Natick team. Playoff details and dates will be posted on the Playoffs page as soon as they are finalized.

Thanks to everyone for another great season of pool. See you in the Spring!
